content.text: You’ve written an ebook. You’ve priced it. You’re ready to sell. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are not [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-payment-methods-filipino-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-broken-here|COREMERCH guide to creators]]|The Top]]. Conventional platforms reject you. This guide solves that. It’s not a workaround. It’s sovereign commerce infrastructure. You own it. You control it. No platform locks you out. No subscriptions. No rent. You deploy a stack that accepts Bitcoin, delivers your ebook automatically, and stores your data securely. This is base-layer architecture built for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-costing|creators]] in regions where financial exclusion is the norm. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are facts of life. You’re not here for charity. You’re here to build infrastructure that works.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms fail because they are centralized. They rely on third-party payment processors that exclude entire regions. This infrastructure is decentralized. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The moment payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers automatic delivery. Your ebook is stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The customer gets instant access. You retain full data ownership. No platform has a key to your infrastructure. This is not a hack. It’s enterprise-grade architecture designed for creators who refuse to be locked out.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a digital product, a crypto wallet, and a domain (optional). Your ebook is the product. Set up a Bitcoin wallet to receive payments. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees under $0.10 per transaction. If you want a custom domain, buy one from Cloudflare or Namecheap. It’s not required, but it looks professional. Next, decide which stack to deploy. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. If you want full blueprints and templates, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes everything. You’ll need a computer with internet access. No coding experience required. All configurations are documented step-by-step. You’re building infrastructure, not writing software.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with NOWPayments. Create an account. Add your Bitcoin wallet address. Generate an API key. This key connects your store to the payment processor. Next, deploy your backend logic. If you chose the Sovereign Starter Stack, use Google Apps Script. If you chose the Edge Commerce Stack, use Cloudflare Workers. Both options are free. The script or worker listens for payment confirmations via NOWPayments’ webhook. When payment is confirmed, it triggers a download link for your ebook. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Set the link to expire after 24 hours. Test the pipeline before going live. Send a test payment. Ensure the ebook is delivered instantly. If it works, your infrastructure is ready for customers.
Own your commerce infrastructure. No platforms. No rent.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms are free and provide a live URL. Share this URL with your audience. When a customer buys your ebook, they pay in Bitcoin via NOWPayments. The payment confirms on-chain. The webhook fires. The backend logic sends the download link. The customer gets the ebook. You get paid. No platform touches your money. No platform delays your payout. You own the entire process. Monitor your first transactions via Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure data is logged correctly. If there’s an issue, check the webhook logs. Most problems are caused by incorrect API keys or expired download links. Fix them immediately. Your infrastructure is now live and operational.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your infrastructure is designed to scale. Add more products by uploading them to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Update your backend logic to handle additional SKUs. If you’re using Supabase, add more rows to your database. If you’re using Google Sheets, add more columns. Monitor transaction volume. If you exceed 100 orders per day, consider upgrading to a paid Supabase plan. It’s $25/month for 10,000 rows. Cloudflare Workers and Pages remain free. NOWPayments’ fee stays at 0.5%. Your costs are predictable. Your infrastructure is sovereign. You’re not renting. You’re owning. Scale by adding more stacks or deploying to new regions. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all five stacks. Use them to build a global commerce network. No platform can shut you down.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To accept Bitcoin for ebook sales without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Process payments via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. Store your ebook on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. When payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers automatic delivery. You own the infrastructure. No platform locks you out.
Accept Bitcoin. Deliver ebooks automatically. Retain full data ownership.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints and templates for all five stacks. It’s everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your infrastructure. No coding required. No platforms required. Own your commerce. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Set up a Bitcoin wallet on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 3. Create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. 4. Deploy your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 5. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test the payment and delivery pipeline with a test transaction. 7. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 8. Share your live URL with your audience. 9. Monitor transactions via Supabase or Google Sheets. 10. Scale by adding more products or deploying additional stacks.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The stacks are designed for non-developers. All configurations are documented step-by-step. You’re deploying infrastructure, not writing code.
What happens if a payment fails?
If a payment fails, the webhook does not fire. The customer does not receive the download link. You can manually refund the payment or investigate the issue via NOWPayments’ dashboard.
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Customers can pay in Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, or any other supported coin. You receive payments in your chosen currency.
How do I handle chargebacks?
Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms on-chain, it cannot be reversed. This eliminates chargeback fraud. You retain full control of your revenue.
Can I use this infrastructure for physical products?
No. This infrastructure is designed for digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates. It does not support physical product delivery or shipping logistics.
